name: mcp-server
title: MCP Server
description: An OAuth-protected MCP server as a Supabase Edge Function, with Streamable HTTP transport and a composable tool registry.
docs: Set `[functions.mcp-server].verify_jwt = false` in `supabase/config.toml`, then deploy the included migration and Edge Function. Enable the Supabase OAuth server, dynamic client registration, and custom access-token hook. Set the Auth Site URL to the origin hosting `/oauth/consent`. The block accepts audience-bound OAuth tokens from external agent harnesses; ordinary user JWTs are rejected. Add the [OAuth Consent block](https://supabase.com/library/docs/nextjs/oauth-consent) for the browser-side consent UI. OAuth scopes control identity claims, not tool or data access, so enforce every operation with RLS and use `client_id` where a policy must distinguish clients. Dynamic registration permits any compatible client to register; review clients and let users revoke grants. If the project already has a custom access-token hook, merge the migration's audience logic into it rather than configuring a second hook. See the [MCP authentication guide](https://supabase.com/docs/guides/auth/oauth-server/mcp-authentication) and [token security guide](https://supabase.com/docs/guides/auth/oauth-server/token-security).
